title: sanctum_login_with_valid_and_invalid_credentials
description: Test POST /api/login with valid master and cashier credentials to receive 200 and a Sanctum token, and with invalid password to receive 401. Verify GET /api/user with valid token returns user profile and with missing or revoked token returns 401. Test POST /api/logout revokes token and subsequent GET /api/user returns 401.

title: journals_rbac_access_control_and_validation
description: Test POST /api/journals endpoint to ensure only master users can create journals. Verify balanced journal lines return 201 and unbalanced lines return 422. Confirm cashier and branch admin roles receive 403 on POST and GET /api/journals. Unauthenticated requests return 401.

title: consolidated_financial_reports_access_and_data_scope
description: Test GET /api/reports/balance-sheet, /income-statement, and /sales endpoints with master and non-master tokens. Verify master receives consolidated data with zero difference in balance sheet. Non-master users receive branch-scoped data without leakage. Unauthenticated requests receive 401.

title: master_data_access_control_for_branches_categories_and_products
description: Test GET and POST on /api/branches, /api/categories, and /api/products with master, branch admin, and cashier roles. Verify only master can create branches and categories. Confirm cashier receives 403 on product creation. Authenticated users can read categories. Branch admin can create products if allowed by policy.

title: branch_isolation_in_product_listing_and_barcode_lookup
description: Test GET /api/products and /api/products/barcode/{barcode} with tokens from Pakan and Pupuk branch admins. Verify product listings and barcode lookups are limited to caller's branch and do not leak data from other division branches, including other_branch_stock field. Requests without token return 401.

title: checkout_and_goods_receipt_stock_and_accounting_integration
description: Test POST /api/checkout with valid in-stock items and discounts to receive 200 and balanced journal entries. Verify over-stock quantity or invalid discounts return 422 and no stock change. Test POST /api/goods-receipts increases stock and posts balanced inventory journal. Confirm purchase orders alone do not change stock.
